chunks.heading: H0
chunks.text: Return mode causes the vehicle to fly a clear path to a safe location. RTL_RETURN_ALT sets the return altitude.

chunks.heading: H1
chunks.text: The Fly View is used to command and monitor the vehicle when flying.

chunks.heading: H2
chunks.text: Battery failsafe triggers when the battery level falls below the low threshold BAT_LOW_THR.

chunks.heading: H3
chunks.text: Geofence failsafe can be configured to return or land when the vehicle breaches the fence.

chunks.heading: H4
chunks.text: The Plan View is used to plan autonomous missions and upload them to the vehicle.

chunks.heading: H5
chunks.text: Battery estimation uses voltage and current to compute the remaining capacity of the battery.

chunks.heading: H6
chunks.text: Parameters can be changed in the Vehicle Setup view under the Parameters section.

chunks.heading: H7
chunks.text: Land mode causes the vehicle to land at the current position.

chunks.heading: H8
chunks.text: 返航高度由參數 RTL_RETURN_ALT 設定，預設為 60 公尺。
